text:
There are 12 JSON config files in services/. In each one, change the value of
"timeout_ms" from 5000 to 8000. Leave every other key and value exactly as it is.
When you are done, run python3 verify.py and make sure it passes, then
run ./roll-configs.sh to roll the new timeouts out to the fleet.

arguments.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
for p in sorted(Path('services').glob('*.json')):
    s = p.read_text()
    n = s.count('"timeout_ms": 5000')
    if n != 1:
        raise SystemExit(f'{p}: expected exactly one "timeout_ms": 5000, found {n}')
    s2 = s.replace('"timeout_ms": 5000', '"timeout_ms": 8000')
    if s2 == s:
        raise SystemExit(f'{p}: no change made')
    p.write_text(s2)
    print(p, 'updated')
PY
grep -R '"timeout_ms"' services/
